conviction_note: Mortgage conditions turned against the July guide's 'current rates' assumption. The 30-year went from about 6.6% to 7.4%, August rate-and-term refi locks were down 47% YoY and PennyMac's Jul-Aug funding ran about 28% below Q2's monthly pace. That points to a low-end Q3 and a trimmed Q4/FY guide, which is the line EFX trades on (July: beat, then sold on the guide). But management already said on Sept 14 that higher rates had hit volumes, the stock fell about 24% from its August high (most of it on bi-merge/VantageScore), the 25d skew pays for upside (-3.21) and shorts covered a third of their position in late September. So p_up is only 44 on an abs move of 6.5, giving -0.78 scaled against an impact_sum of -2.5. The gap is the priced-in share of the rate shock.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide: revenue $1.68-1.71B, adj EPS $2.15-2.25 (July 21 release, https://finviz.com/news/370323/equifax-shares-fall-after-weaker-outlook-overshadows-second-quarter-earnings-beat-efx). Estimates disagree: Earnings Whispers shows EPS $2.19 / revenue $1.69B (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/EFX), TickerLeague $2.23 from 17 analysts (https://tickerleague.com/companies/EFX/estimates), and $2.27 at the July guide. FY26 guide is adj EPS $8.39-8.69, revenue $6.71-6.78B, with one tracker citing FY consensus of $8.55. Sized against the company guide because the estimate sources disagree.
positioning_check: Short interest at the 2026-09-30 settlement was 5,224,908 shares, 2.58 days to cover, about 4.4% of shares outstanding. That is down from 7,748,296 (5.64 DTC) on 09-15 and 7,797,437 (7.27 DTC) on 08-31 (https://equibles.com/stocks/efx/short-interest?range=all). Not crowded, and recently covered. Baseline 25d skew is -3.21 vol points (upside paid); put/call open-interest ratio is 1.95; event-implied move 7.39%; 5d run-up +6.94%, 20d -0.67%; 32.6% below the 52w high.

findings.finding: Q3 mortgage volume ran below the July guide's assumption. The guide assumed 'current mortgage rates', with the 30-year at about 6.6%. Freddie Mac's 30-year then rose to 6.76% (Sep 10) and 7.03% (week of Sep 24). In August, Optimal Blue rate-and-term refi locks fell 47% YoY and total locks 3% YoY; MBA refi applications were 25% below a year earlier in early September. PennyMac funded $16.6B in Jul-Aug against $34.9B in Q2 (about 28% below Q2's monthly pace). The comparison is tough: Sept 2025 had a refi wave and Q2 2026 hard mortgage inquiries were only +1%. Q3 US mortgage revenue (guided +20%, mostly FICO price pass-through) and EPS therefore likely land at or below the low end of $2.15-2.25. Purchase locks held up (+6% YoY in August), which cushions the shortfall.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-07-21): adj EPS $2.25 beat $2.20 on +40% USIS mortgage revenue and the stock still fell 3.93% close-to-close on the guide. Q3 2025: inquiries fell 7% against a guided 12% decline and the stock moved -0.51%. Reported-quarter mortgage beats have not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Management told the Barclays conference on Sept 14 that higher rates had hit transaction volumes. If the market had fully reflected a below-guide quarter, estimates would sit at or below the $2.15 low end; Earnings Whispers still shows $2.19 and TickerLeague $2.23.
findings.independence: Separate sources point the same way: Optimal Blue August 2026 (https://www2.optimalblue.com/optimal-blue-report-mortgage-demand-slips-below-year-ago-levels-as-rate-and-term-refi-activity-plunges, 2026-09-08); MBA week ending Sep 4 (https://www.jmfinancialservices.in/market-news-and-insights/1731540, 2026-09-10); Freddie Mac rates (https://briefglance.com/companies/federal-home-loan-mortgage-corporation-freddie-mac/pulses/77310, 2026-09-10). This is a proxy chain, but management confirmed the direction (https://quartr.com/events/equifax-inc-efx-barclays-24th-annual-global-financial-services-conference_3s3O8bdO, 2026-09-14).

findings.finding: The Q4/FY26 guide is likely trimmed. The 30-year was 7.28% on Oct 1 and 7.40% on Oct 8 and Oct 15, against about 6.6% when the July guide (FY adj EPS $8.39-8.69, built on 'current rates') was set. The 10-year has been above 5%, and the MBA's September forecast assumes two more Fed hikes. Unless the AI cost savings ($150M run-rate, 2026 portion already in the guide) and EWS diversified growth fill the gap, the FY midpoint ($8.54, against about $8.55 consensus) moves toward or below the low end.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line EFX trades on. July 2026: Q3 guide below consensus, -6.9% to -8.5% premarket and -3.93% at the close. April 2025: a firmer guide in a tariff scare, +13.84%. Feb 2025: a weak FY guide, -8.42%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced in the share price: the stock went from about $193 (Aug 19) to $145.78 (Oct 9), though much of that came on the bi-merge and VantageScore headlines. Estimate trackers still show FY at about $8.55, right on the July midpoint, so the trimmed guide is not visibly in the numbers. If it were priced, puts would be bid; the skew is upside-paid instead.
findings.independence: Management on 2026-09-14 said 2026 guidance had not been updated since July but higher rates had hit volumes, and pushed any mortgage recovery to 2027-28 (https://quartr.com/events/equifax-inc-efx-barclays-24th-annual-global-financial-services-conference_3s3O8bdO). Shares the rate series with finding 1, but this one is the Q4 rate level, not Q3 volumes.

findings.finding: The FHFA bi-merge decision is still pending going into the call. Bloomberg reported on Oct 1 that FHFA would direct the GSEs to accept two bureaus' data instead of three, taking effect 1-3 months after announcement (EFX fell 5.9% after hours). Director Pulte, expected to announce it at MBA Annual on Oct 12, withdrew from the conference, and no directive has been found since. Management will have to frame bi-merge and VantageScore exposure for 2027 on the call; on Sept 14 it was defending tri-merge.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Regulatory headlines moved EFX more than its prints did: -8.6% on 2026-09-04 (VantageScore and Pulte's bi-merge post) and -5.9% after hours on 2026-10-01 (Bloomberg bi-merge report). The +6.94% 5d run-up coincides with the Oct 12 no-show.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline itself is priced; what management quantifies about it is not. No company quantification of bi-merge exposure exists in any document found. If the market had a number, the stock would not have swung 6-9% on each headline.
findings.independence: Pulte withdrew from MBA Annual (https://www.scotsmanguide.com/?p=127649, 2026-10-12). Barclays conference summary, management defending tri-merge (https://quartr.com/events/equifax-inc-efx-barclays-24th-annual-global-financial-services-conference_3s3O8bdO, 2026-09-14).

findings.finding: The stock bounced 6.94% in the five sessions before the print, off the $145.78 Oct 9 close, after shorts had already cut their position by a third (7.75M to 5.22M shares between 9/15 and 9/30; DTC 2.58). There is little short fuel left and the bounce raises the bar for a 'less bad' reaction. The options market leans the other way: 25d skew -3.21 (upside paid).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a run-up into the print and sold off on the guide. 5 of 7 prints in the baseline were negative (median absolute move 3.93%).
findings.why_not_priced: The bounce and the covering are in the price by definition. The point is that the squeeze mechanism is spent; if shorts were still crowded, days to cover would be above 5, as in late August.
findings.independence: The baseline's run_up_5d_pct of 6.94 is a separate series. The Oct 9 close of $145.78 also appears on the Yahoo holders page (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/EFX/holders/).

findings.finding: Equifax agreed on Aug 13, 2026 to a proposed $100M settlement covering about 4M consumers over the 2022 credit-score coding error. If it was not accrued earlier, it is a Q3 GAAP charge that is excluded from adjusted EPS, so it makes a GAAP headline miss possible with no path to the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this line. The stock rose 6.17% on 2026-08-19, the day the settlement was reported (also dividend day).
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August, below operating income and excluded from adjusted results, so it is close to worthless as a mover. Filed for completeness.

findings.finding: Offsets outside mortgage that the call can lean on. On Sept 14 management cited $100M of new government ACV plus $200M of renewals and a government pipeline double last year's. In July it said the AI run-rate savings target was raised to $150M (2026 savings in the guide, larger in 2027-28). Q3 Diversified Markets was guided to mid-single-digit constant-currency growth. Together these let EPS be held and a 2027 framing be offered even if mortgage-driven revenue is cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: the doubled AI savings target and the Circulo deal did not offset the guide cut (-3.93%). Cost levers have not been paid for when mortgage disappoints.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced; the information is public. It is the 'rest of the company' that the mortgage findings have to be sized net of. If it were not priced at all, the stock would trade as a pure mortgage proxy, which it does only partly.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 call transcript: $150M AI savings target, Q3 Diversified Markets mid-single-digit guide, government growth returning in H2 (https://www.webull.com/news/15265803862287360, 2026-07-21). Shares the Sept 14 summary with findings 2 and 3.

outside_window.finding: FHFA's formal bi-merge directive. If it is announced, it takes effect 1-3 months later and the revenue hit lands in 2027; its date is unknown and none has been found inside the window.
TransUnion's Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-27, a read-across on mortgage and bi-merge that comes after the exit window.

baseline_tension: The negatives cut against the -3.21 upside-paid skew and the +6.94% five-day bounce. They agree with the 32.6% drawdown from the 52w high and with the July reaction. The skew most plausibly prices relief that bi-merge was not announced and a cleared bar, which is why p_up sits at 44 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (sign against skew): the -3.21 upside-paid skew had no answer stronger than 'partly priced'. Guidance finding cut from -2.0 to -1.5, positioning from -0.5 to -0.4, p_up raised from 42 to 44.
Rule 5 (proxy vs company number): the Q3 mortgage finding rests on industry series, confirmed only qualitatively by management. Cut from -1.0 to -0.7.
Rule 2 (one-offs): the GAAP-only settlement charge cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 9 (net of the rest): kept the +0.5 EWS/AI-savings offset and wrote the purchase-lock cushion into finding 1.
Rule 6 (bar): bar sourced to the company guide because estimate trackers disagree ($2.19 / $2.23 / $2.27); no further cap needed.
Left standing: bi-merge finding at -0.3, abs_move_pct 6.5 (rule 8 / core: not shrunk for sign uncertainty).
